mentions.note: died suddenly last December; won 24 hours track walk at Motspur Park 1948 with 122 miles 1,411 yards; won London to Brighton and Back in 18hrs. 46m.; Tommy Green Cup; Club Honours Badge; percussionist at the Royal Opera House; first Hon. Editor of the Road Runners Club Newsletter; represented Hampshire
won 24 hours race at Motspur Park 1948, Centurion No. 143 in 18:56:13, 122 miles 1411 yards; won Brighton and Back three years later in 18:46:0; death recently reported
Belgrave walker; founded the R.R.C. Newsletter in December 1952; won 24 Hours Track Walk at Motspur Park 1948 and London to Brighton and Back Walk 1951

share.d: Jack Stirling-Wakeley in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1950–1995: 5 mentions in 5 issues and 2 race results.
